arabic text: Jibreel nawha parte hai, mare gaye Ali\nMaula-e-kayinaat pe talwaar chalgayi
english translation text: Jibraeel recites a lament: Ali has been struck down\nA sword has fallen upon the Master of all creation

arabic text:
Masjid udaas mimbare kufa udaas hai
Tar khoon me khuda ke wali ka libaas hai
Rota hai asmaan zami(n) ghamse phat gayi
Jibreel nawha parte hai, mare gaye Ali
Maula-e-kayinaat pe talwaar chalgayi
english translation text:
The mosque is desolate; the pulpit of Kufa is desolate
The garment of God's wali is soaked in blood
The heavens weep and the earth has split from grief
Jibraeel recites a lament: Ali has been struck down
A sword has fallen upon the Master of all creation

arabic text:
Masjid me rozadar par kaysa sitam huwa
Kabe se aa rahi hai sadaa wa musibata
Ghamse nabi ki kabr bhi ab kaampne lagi
Jibreel nawha parte hai, mare gaye Ali
Maula-e-kayinaat pe talwaar chalgayi
english translation text:
What oppression was committed against the fasting one in the mosque?
From the Kaaba comes the cry: what a calamity!
Even the Prophet's grave has begun to tremble from grief
Jibraeel recites a lament: Ali has been struck down
A sword has fallen upon the Master of all creation

arabic text:
Haay haay yateem Shabbar-o-Shabbir hogaye
Abbas dilko thaamke rote huwe chale
Sarse ridaaye Zainab-o-Kulsum girgayi
Jibreel nawha parte hai, mare gaye Ali
Maula-e-kayinaat pe talwaar chalgayi
english translation text:
Alas, Shabbar and Shabbir have been orphaned
Abbas walked away weeping, clutching his heart
The veils fell from the heads of Zainab and Kulsum
Jibraeel recites a lament: Ali has been struck down
A sword has fallen upon the Master of all creation

arabic text:
Duniya mei bekaso ka sahara nahi raha
Utraa tha jo falak se sitara nahi raha
Arshe bareen pe farshe azaa aaj bichgayi
Jibreel nawha parte hai, mare gaye Ali
Maula-e-kayinaat pe talwaar chalgayi
english translation text:
The helpless of the world no longer have a protector
The star that descended from the heavens is no more
A mourning floor has been spread upon the highest Throne
Jibraeel recites a lament: Ali has been struck down
A sword has fallen upon the Master of all creation

arabic text:
Maula mera jo khoon me apne naha gaya
Bole farishte haye ye kaisa sitam huwa
Hurrain ye roke kehti thi duniya ujargayi
Jibreel nawha parte hai, mare gaye Ali
Maula-e-kayinaat pe talwaar chalgayi
english translation text:
My Master became drenched in his own blood
The angels cried: alas, what oppression is this?
The maidens of Paradise wept, saying the world has been ruined
Jibraeel recites a lament: Ali has been struck down
A sword has fallen upon the Master of all creation

arabic text:
Zehra lahad me roti hai Haider ke waste
Kehti hai cheyn kabr ke andar nahi muje
Bacho pe mere gham ki ghata aaj chhagayi
Jibreel nawha parte hai, mare gaye Ali
Maula-e-kayinaat pe talwaar chalgayi
english translation text:
Zahra weeps in her grave for Haider
She says: I find no peace within this grave
A cloud of grief has gathered over my children today
Jibraeel recites a lament: Ali has been struck down
A sword has fallen upon the Master of all creation

arabic text: "Rehan" mere saath me rone lagaa kalam\nAankho se mere jaari huwe ayse ashke gham\nChalte huwe kalam ke mere saas rukh gayi
english translation text: "Rehan", my pen began to weep beside me\nSuch tears of grief flowed from my eyes\nEven the breath of my moving pen came to a halt
